title: Pullback along a morphism admitting a map back over the base is an equivalence on descent data
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f: X' to X over S admitting a morphism g: X to X' over S (in particular when f has a section), the lemma shows that the pullback functor on descent data between the two bases is an equivalence of categories (statement lines 8896-8904). The proof is short but complete: it observes that the two composites of the pullback functors along f and g are pullbacks along the composites g composed with f and f composed with g, and that the cited lemma identifies those with the respective identity functors, which exhibits the functors as mutually inverse up to isomorphism (proof lines 8906-8911). The claim is H2: the content is recognizing that mutual invertibility follows from the self-map statement, and the two composites are named explicitly.
